scope: Independent static review: one S19 zero-generation reconstruction control followed only on success by four fixed domain-end readouts. No actual restoration or model was executed by this review.
boundary_evidence: The local manifest projection agrees with the hash-bound original manifest, the sealed task/domain records and old domain audit. Worker and verifier independently recompute all boundaries from the actual manifest before accepting the new cohort.
checks: Every phase starts a fresh original language base and installs only the fixed visual asset; the language digest matches the original unadapted base.

Each phase loads exactly one complete cumulative A/B snapshot; snapshot file SHA is checked after STARTED against the original train receipt. No addition of snapshots or folding on a previously folded base.
Snapshot helper checks all 96 canonical FP32 A/B keys, shapes, finiteness, 4399104 coordinates and 17596416 tensor bytes against the original stage adapter digest.

The immutable mask is defined by excluding fixed A/B names, preserving original frozen, visual and nonvisual-buffer digests before and after copying. A/B Parameter identity and pre-fold trainable names remain intact.
Worker explicitly binds STAGE_record.stage to the requested snapshot stage, then uses the original CPU FP32 fold and original FP16 storage.
The original adaptation/interface/BudgetQV bytes are reused; no repeated synthetic CPU gate is required. The actual S19 full digest/layout/visual/RoPE control is the sole new reconstruction control.
Controller completes control19 first and aborts on failure; every domain worker also checks its successful control digest before any generation.
Exactly the original 20 DEV per nontraffic domain, image SHA, prepared features/text, references and generation cap are checked. No historical peak selection or partial scoring.
All 5 phases share the selected OLD GPU and run serially, each with 180 seconds from its own STARTED, total 900 model seconds. No retries.
limits: Source acceptance is not proof that the real restoration control has passed; the S19 full-graph digest must match the already-sealed final graph before the 80 answers are attempted.
Only domain-end to S19 net changes are measured. Domain-end performance is not strictly just-acquired performance, particularly for multi-task medical/geography domains.
The full parent final score is a design target, not a matched-stage parent control. No unique forgetting/capacity/optimization cause or automatic training/bridge/rank rescue follows.
The old compact representation plus 87-update fixed point remains closed.
